ننطلق (form VII)
# نَنْطَلِقُ (nanṭaliqu) /nan.tˤa.li.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْطَلَقَ (inṭalaqa)
# نَنْطَلِقَ (nanṭaliqa) /nan.tˤa.li.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَلَقَ (inṭalaqa)
# نَنْطَلِقْ (nanṭaliq) /nan.tˤa.liq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْطَلَقَ (inṭalaqa)
